system.description: A Focus for using shadows and darkness to move unseen, quickly, and smoothly.

abilities.name: Always Speedy
abilities.description: Restore one extra Speed point whenever a recovery restores Speed, up to three selections.

abilities.name: Natural Sneak
abilities.description: Treat a lockpicking, perception, pickpocketing, or stealth roll below 6 as a 6; the minimum rises to 9 at tier 3.

abilities.name: Eyes Adjusted
abilities.description: See in very dim light as bright light and in total darkness as very dim light.

abilities.name: Underworld Contacts
abilities.description: Know people involved in illegal activities who recognize you as a peer, though they may not be friends or trustworthy.

abilities.name: Safe Fall
abilities.description: Ignore one wound from a fall.

abilities.name: Retaliatory Swipe
abilities.description: After a melee attack hits you, immediately make a melee attack against the attacker, once per turn.

abilities.name: Nine Lives
abilities.description: Use Might or Speed Effort on block rolls.

abilities.name: Unbalancing Strike
abilities.description: Make an eased melee attack that hinders all of the target’s actions on its next turn if it hits.

abilities.name: Hard-Won Resilience
abilities.description: You can sustain one more moderate wound than normal.

abilities.name: Dirty Fighter
abilities.description: Make a Speed attack against a distant foe to hinder its attacks and defenses until a ten-minute recovery.

abilities.name: Slippery Customer
abilities.description: Ignore penalties from darkness and cramped spaces, and gain an asset on stealth tasks in dim light or darkness.

abilities.name: Again and Again
abilities.description: Take an extra action on your turn.

abilities.name: Alley Rat
abilities.description: In a city, find or create a significant shortcut, secret entrance, or emergency escape route with an Intellect task.
